'''Green Five''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in [[Ghost Squadron]]. They served under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and clone pilot [[Ghost Leader]] during an escort mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]].<ref name="SW:RS" />
